title: "CHASING ICE" captures largest glacier calving ever filmed - OFFICIAL VIDEO
summary: Footage from the Chasing Ice project of the largest glacier calving event ever filmed, at Greenland's Ilulissat Glacier in 2008. A 75-minute event is condensed to a few minutes of cameras watching ice collapse.
why: Recommended whenever glaciers come up, as a stunning look at the scale of calving.

quote.text: If you have never seen a glacier calve before, check out these videos
